# Organizations

Manage global organization, account, hierarchy and SCP records.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `organizations` |
| Signing name | `organizations` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2016-11-28` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Records |
| Selected operations | 32 of 63 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#organizations) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- SCPs are records and do not enforce permissions; other policy types, delegated administration, invitations, handshakes and service access are unsupported.
- CreateAccount RoleName and IamUserAccessToBilling are rejected; no IAM role, credentials or billing configuration is provisioned; STS credential resolution works but Organizations does not change IAM/STS behavior.
- Management account email/name are local defaults (<account>@tinystack.local and Management account); account removal does not implement AWS billing prerequisites.
- CloudFormation Account and ResourcePolicy are unsupported; no Organizations management console pages.
- Input members outside the generated profile and unsupported enum/filter values fail explicitly.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
